name: wechat
description: WeChat has no officially published MCP server; Tencent opened the iLink / ClawBot personal Bot protocol (ilinkai.weixin.qq.com) in 2026. This example uses the community wrapper wechat-mcp built on that protocol (static Go binary, standard library only, MIT, stdio). On Windows it builds wechat-mcp.exe and WECHAT_MCP_STATE overrides the state file path.

metadata.install: git clone https://github.com/JingxuanC/wechat-mcp && cd wechat-mcp && go build -o bin\wechat-mcp.exe .\cmd\wechat-mcp
metadata.env_hint: WECHAT_MCP_STATE (Windows has no XDG convention; set it explicitly)
